paragraphs.text: Miriam is a Atiin druid from an unknown plane.

Miriam is a character who debut in Outlaws of Thunder Junction . She is someone from an unknown plane who arrived on Thunder Junction between 4562 and c. 4563 AR after the opening of the Omenpaths . She is likely a member of the Atiin . On Thunder Junction, Miriam joined the Freestriders and wears their sun adornment on her armor. As a druid, she has great respect for nature, and she has access to magic that allows her to communicate with animals, as well as fortifying, strengthening, and protecting them.
